name: net_activation_lease_menu
description: Focused native activation lease expiry control: two peers in BC05/06, fresh accepted lease plus actual qualified Apply, native host Start-menu pause while runtimes stay connected, >500ms expiry followed by repeated same-controller Hold with unchanged Apply count and no new lease, then native resume/fresh source/Apply in unchanged epoch/full location. Uses complete per-PID regex-record index boundaries and fresh runtime log suffixes; all menu controls and qualification must be observed, never assumed. Menu control is uncalibrated until first live pass. Does not assert enemy parity or authoritative spawn completeness. Same-room reload/latejoin are covered by net_host_transitions_smoke; reconnect has portable lease/transport coverage, no live runner stop/rejoin step.

steps.expr: all(row['location'] == [5,6,0,1,1,0] for row in saved['settled']['instances'].values())
